candidates.priorities_note: His "Main Ideas" page is a list of dated posts, not a ranked list of issues, so there's no top 3. His stances below come from those posts.

cost-of-living.heading: Living Wage
cost-of-living.quote: I propose we tie the federal minimum wage to the MIT Living Wage Calculator set to single adult with no kids. This would be on a county by county basis for the employer and would be reevaluated every year on January 1st.

health-care.heading: Medicare for all
health-care.quote: If I were leading the charge in Washington on how to overhaul runaway healthcare costs I would switch us to a Medicare for All system. No more Medicaid, TriCare, VA etc. All rolled into Medicare.

immigration.heading: Good neighbors
immigration.quote: I would under no circumstance be a Yes vote for ICE appropriations while we continue this shameful and lawless practice. I would be a Yes vote to claw back appropriations that are supporting ICE as it currently exists.

foreign-policy.heading: Israel and Palestine
foreign-policy.quote: We must stop all military aid to the country of Israel until they have stopped this campaign and begun to make restitution.

climate-energy.heading: Energy Independence for Our Government
climate-energy.quote: If we were to appropriate the funds to put solar in to power our buildings we would get that money back within 7-10 years.
